declarations.name: Causal.Causality.hasChronalNeighbourEverywhere_of_forall_mem_Zplus
declarations.notes: ∀ {M} [TopologicalSpace M] {C : Causality M}, (∀ p, p ∈ C.Zplus) → C.HasChronalNeighbourEverywhere. This is the statement the target's evidence gives. Proof: fun p => Or.inl (Iplus_nonempty_of_mem_Zplus (h p)). The left disjunct of HasChronalNeighbour is (C.Iplus ⊤ {p}).Nonempty, checked by #print. Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

declarations.name: Causal.E0LM.LocZplus.chronalFutureNeighbours
declarations.notes: ∀ {X} [TopologicalSpace X] {D : Causality X}, E0LM.LocZplus D → D.ChronalFutureNeighbours. This is the statement the target's evidence gives. Proof: LocZplus read with N = V. Axioms: propext, Quot.sound.
